Blockhold · September 9, 2026

More room to play.
A room you can rejoin.

Mobile controls, clearer hunts, shared battle recovery and room to grow your endless defense.

Ruleset 9 · mobile and co-op update

Mobile controls

The battlefield stays in view.

1 Hero2 Signature3 Meteor4 Reinforcements

Tap on, tap off

The hero portrait toggles selection. Fullscreen has its own battle button and V shortcut on supported browsers.

Overcharge all shows the combined shard cost for every ready attacking tower, skipping active charges and cooldowns.

Choose the rendering load

Settings offer Automatic, High, Balanced, Low and Battery saver. Low removes shadows and reduces effects; Battery saver also draws at up to 30 fps.

Simulation speed stays unchanged. Tests verify equal combat ticks at 30 and 60 render frames; this is not a physical-device temperature benchmark.

Co-op

Keep the same defense.

Solo → shared → solo

  1. Pause and choose Invite a friend to this battle.
  2. Copy invite link from settings.
  3. Your friend joins the existing board.

Continue this battle solo keeps a local copy. Your ally can keep playing in the room.

Reconnect and chat

A temporary disconnect catches up automatically. After a reload, use Co-op → Rejoin your room.

Room chat starts collapsed with an unread badge. Typing cannot cast abilities or move the camera.

Rooms are held in server memory: server restarts end them, and empty rooms are retained for ten minutes. Very old history cannot be rebuilt. Solo saves remain separate.

See the two-player browser check
Endless

Every 15 clears, a new foundation.

Completed endless waves bank plot credits. Tap Plot, then choose clear ground. Roads, obstacles, water and existing plots are protected; an invalid placement keeps your credit.

Boss hunts

A clear next challenge.

Pick a champion and difficulty, then start either hunt. The board explains the next reward; hero paths and mastery details open when you need them.

Checked against real play paths.

  • Older ruleset 8 solo saves validate with their original hash and migrate to ruleset 9.
  • Shared battles preserve the host’s initial loadout while retaining each player’s account.
  • Touch controls, compact layouts, quality persistence and reload recovery run in Chromium against the production bundle.

347 game tests and 48 server tests pass, along with typechecks, ESLint and the compressed bundle budget. Browser checks cover 21 play paths.

Uses Blockhold’s existing wood, parchment and gold palette. All game images come from its Three.js renderer. Expand images to inspect them.
